picks.editorial_note: Berkeley Lab's leadership on 13 projects and partnership on 30+ more makes it the single largest node in DOE's new Genesis Mission, the flagship national push to fuse AI, supercomputing, and quantum resources for scientific discovery.
picks.title: Berkeley Lab to Lead 13 New Genesis Mission AI Projects

picks.editorial_note: Oak Ridge's role leading nine Genesis Mission projects and contributing to 32 others cements the national labs as the backbone of the DOE's AI-for-science strategy, with outsized influence over how the initiative's compute and data resources are deployed.
picks.title: Department of Energy selects ORNL to lead nine Genesis Mission projects | ORNL

picks.editorial_note: NASA's entry into the whole-of-government Genesis Mission, alongside 15+ federal agencies under an executive order, signals that AI-accelerated science is becoming durable federal policy rather than a single-agency program.
picks.title: NASA Joins Genesis Mission to Accelerate AI-Driven Discovery - NASA

picks.editorial_note: CuspAI's £330 million raise at a £2 billion valuation, with an Imperial College scientist as Chief Scientific Officer, is a rare AI-for-materials-discovery deal at this scale and shows academic science translating directly into venture-backed industry.
picks.title: Imperial expert leads science at £2 billion AI materials company CuspAI

picks.editorial_note: NSF's $20 million award to build a national 'cloud lab' network of 20 AI-infused remote-experiment nodes could reshape how automated science is run across universities, not just at Boston University.
picks.title: NSF Awards Boston University $20 Million to Help Create National “Cloud Lab” Network

picks.editorial_note: An $83 million NSF investment in AI-ready data infrastructure addresses a foundational bottleneck for AI-driven science across the entire research ecosystem, not just a single institution's output.
picks.title: NSF announces $83M investment in integrated data systems and services to advance AI-driven science and strengthen U.S. research infrastructure

picks.editorial_note: Berkeley Lab's ModCon consortium is building self-improving AI foundation models trained on DOE data and facilities — a genuine technical leap beyond the typical application-specific grant, with implications for how future AI-for-science tools are built.
picks.title: Q&A: Accelerating Scientific Discovery with the Genesis Mission’s ModCon

picks.editorial_note: USC's national team developing AI turbulence-prediction models has cross-cutting applications in energy and transportation, illustrating how a single Genesis Mission project can have outsized real-world reach.
picks.title: USC leads national AI research project to accelerate scientific discovery

picks.editorial_note: Florida State's four Genesis Mission awards target hard scientific problems — fusion energy, quantum error correction, and particle physics — representing some of the most technically ambitious applications of AI in the current DOE cohort.
picks.title: Florida State University secures Department of Energy Genesis Mission awards

picks.editorial_note: Iowa State's involvement in eight separate Genesis Mission projects (leading four) exemplifies the initiative's breadth, weaving mid-tier research universities into a national AI-for-science network alongside the major labs.
picks.title: Several Iowa State research projects selected for U.S. Department of Energy Genesis Mission
